name: recommend_products
description: Personalized product recommendations across Home, Shop and Rewards (1,200 products, 24 categories). Returns the top-k eligible products for a customer, best first, each with plain-language reasons. Use user_id for known customers; pass profile for new customers; pass events to account for what the customer did in the current session. Eligibility (region, device OS, launch date, already-owned durables) is enforced automatically.

user_id.description: Known customer ID, e.g. U024000. Omit for a new customer.

profile.description: Customer profile for new customers. region and device_os determine eligibility.

owned_items.description: Owned durable product IDs to exclude

events.description: Extra interactions not yet in the stored history (e.g. this session). Dates must be before 2026-06-01.
